key_idea: Do the three changes one at a time, in order.
steps: At the start: white, grey, black, white, grey, black, grey, white.
Anni makes black into white: white, grey, white, white, grey, white, grey, white.
Bob makes grey into black: white, black, white, white, black, white, black, white.
Chris makes white into grey: grey, black, grey, grey, black, grey, black, grey.

choice_feedback.A: Squares 3 and 4 both end up grey, so black and grey do not take turns all the way.
choice_feedback.B: The first square starts white, so it ends grey, not black.
choice_feedback.D: The second square starts grey, so Bob makes it black. Here it is grey.
choice_feedback.E: This is the pattern before anyone changed it.
